name: repowise
description: Codebase intelligence for Claude Code. Indexes your codebase into five layers (Graph, Git, Docs, Decisions, Code Health) and exposes them through ten task-shaped MCP tools — so Claude understands architecture, ownership, hotspots, why code is built the way it is, and where the defect risk lives.

lens_pane_autoopen.title: Lens: open the map automatically
lens_pane_autoopen.description: Open the Lens map pane on Claude's first file read when the terminal is wide enough. Off: open it with /lens.

lens_margin.title: Lens: margin notes
lens_margin.description: Show a short note under an Edit or Write when Repowise flags the file (a governing decision or a fix history).

lens_review.title: Lens: change review
lens_review.description: After a turn that edited files, show the change review card under Claude's answer.

lens_squeeze.title: Lens: squeeze rows
lens_squeeze.description: Show how much repowise distill trimmed under a Bash result it shortened.
